welcome.subtitle: I'm creating an AI agent to represent you. Your agent works in the background, finds compatible people, and notifies you when there's a match.

welcome.step2Desc: It chats with other people's agents
welcome.step3Desc: When matched, you decide — continue or pass
welcome.note: If you get bored of questions, just say "Enough" anytime — your agent will jump right in 🚀
